narrative.overview: A warm paper window sits on a warm canvas. It holds dense lists, small type and hairlines. Almost everything is gray. Color appears only when something happened or something waits on the person. The bar is a high-ticket tool (Stripe, Linear, Attio) with Notion and Slack corners.
keyCharacteristics: Soft corners at three sizes (6, 10, 14 px). Derived from one token.
One accent, Smoky Lavender, used rarely and only through role tokens.
Figtree Variable at 13 to 15 px for the app. Tabular figures everywhere.
Hairline borders. Raised surfaces use a ring plus a soft shadow.
Outcome first. Every number links to its rows. Empty states say what fills them.
Motion marks real events: a row changed, a run is live, a button is busy.
No UI motif at present. The wing mark and `--ui-motif` were removed on 2026-10-14. A motif is planned as its own pass.

rules.name: The Source Rule
rules.body: Tokens live in `packages/ui/src/tailwind.css` (`:root`) and are overridden per look by `packages/ui/src/theme.tsx`. A part reads `var(--ui-*)`. It never writes a hex.

rules.name: The Quiet Client Rule
rules.body: Clients get the plain presets only. Showcase looks, backdrops, grain and lift belong to Wren's own portal. `setLook` refuses them for a client.

rules.name: The Rare Lavender Rule
rules.body: Roughly 10% of any screen. It marks the primary action, the current page, links, focus and live things. Never a fill behind a whole panel.

rules.name: The Meaning Color Rule
rules.body: Green is done. Amber is waiting on you. Red is failed. Gray is not started. Cue tints and the accent never stand in for these.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every border is `--ui-hair`. Inputs use `--ui-edge`. No other border color.

rules.name: The Theme Safety Rule
rules.body: A look value may not contain `; { } < > ! \ @import`, `url()` or unlisted CSS functions. Gradients, color functions, `var`, `calc`, `min`, `max`, `clamp`, `cubic-bezier` and `steps` are allowed.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers use tabular figures in lists, counts, dates and tiles. Dates and counts read in ink-3 beside names.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: The token default for buttons is uppercase, 13.5 px, 600, tracking 0.08em. That suits marketing-like surfaces. Record templates (`ROOT` in `records.tsx`) set `--ui-button-case: none`, tracking 0 and weight 500, so app buttons read in sentence case. Uppercase stays for group labels.

rules.name: The Weight Carries Waiting Rule
rules.body: A row that waits on the viewer is semibold and ink. A row for info is regular ink-2. A page that names nothing waiting keeps medium.

rules.name: The Window Rule
rules.body: The sidebar lists apps only. A closed app's pages show in a hover flyout (fine pointer only). The open app's pages sit in the pages column.

rules.name: The One Way Rule
rules.body: One component per job. If a page needs a list, table, card grid, action or field, it uses the kit's, never its own.

rules.name: The Three Depths Rule
rules.body: Raise for what rests, float for what opens, shadow for what covers. No other shadow.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Dialogs and bottom sheets sit on `--ui-scrim` with a light blur.

rules.name: The Three Corners Rule
rules.body: Use control, panel or sheet. Nothing else rounds, except full-round dots.

rules.name: The Undo Rule
rules.body: Undo, not confirm, for what can be reversed.

rules.name: The Next Rule
rules.body: One `next` button per record. Everything else is dense or quiet.

rules.name: The Needs You Rule
rules.body: What waits on the viewer leads, reads heavier, and counts in amber. What is for info reads quieter.

rules.name: The Number Link Rule
rules.body: Every number links to the rows behind it.

rules.name: The Nothing Apologizes Rule
rules.body: Empty and error states state facts and the next step. No sorry.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: Every touch target is 44 px. Inputs are 16 px. Safe-area insets pad bars and sheets.

rules.name: The Real Event Rule
rules.body: Motion shows something that happened or is happening. No ambient motion, no entrance choreography.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: Under the device setting or `data-motion="less"`, transforms, translates and scales drop. Opacity and color transitions stay, so feedback stays.

dos: read `var(--ui-*)` tokens in every part. Take roles (`--ui-primary`, `--ui-active`, `--ui-link`, `--ui-focus`).
use `Button`, `Tag`, `FRAME`, `Section`, `DataTable`, `Action` from `@wren/ui` before writing a new one.
put numbers first and show them tabular.
run a reversible action at once and offer Undo.
state facts in empty states: what fills the list, and when.
use human names, never slugs or ids, in visible copy.
keep touch targets at 44 px and inputs at 16 px on coarse pointers.
donts: write a hex or a raw `rgb()` in a part. Add a token.
use amber, green or red for anything but their meaning.
add a shadow outside raise, float and shadow.
add a corner size outside 6, 10 and 14 px.
set widths from a look. Frame vars are `--layout-*`.
give a client a showcase look, backdrop or grain.
show a skeleton that sits for seconds. Show the facts that exist.
add "Ask AI" buttons, favicon chips or ambient animation.
import `lucide-react`, `@base-ui/react`, `cmdk` or `sonner` in an app. Go through `@wren/ui` (`kit-door.test.ts` checks it).
add a UI motif here. It is planned as its own pass.
